Threshold re-sweep at live K_SL=3.5/K_TP=3.0 geometry (2026-07-16): the 07-08 threshold-floor fix landed the same day as the K_SL widening, so LT/ST were never re-tuned against this stop width with the floor actually enforced. Testing whether a higher entry bar (especially tighter short threshold, since shorts dominate) shrinks that coin-flip bucket.
